Method of Attack: Exploits a vulnerability in Microsoft's handling of NTFS filesystem images to crash Windows computers within seconds, including locked PCs, causing Blue Screen of Death (BSOD).
Malicious malformed NTFS image placed on USB thumb drive triggers system crash when inserted or accessed (e.g., by Windows Defender scan).
Attack Vector: Physical access via USB thumb drive insertion
Indicators of Compromise: Malformed NTFS filesystem image on USB thumb drive
Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) triggered upon USB insertion or file access
